model: Siemens RWF55 boiler controller (Universal Gateway ProtoAir)
equipment_type: Boiler operating controller (RWF55) via ProtoAir gateway
applies_to: Thermal Solutions and Bryan boilers that use a Siemens RWF55 temperature/pressure controller, connected to the Universal Gateway (ProtoAir FPA-W44).
summary: The ProtoAir Universal Gateway polls a Siemens RWF55 boiler controller over Modbus RTU and serves it on BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP. Besides the inputs, setpoints, actuator position and burner alarm, this profile adds remote-operation objects: the BMS can switch the RWF55 to remote mode and then write its setpoint, switching thresholds, burner release, relays K2/K3/K6 and the actuator output.
notes: This ProtoAir profile has 25 objects; the older ProtoNode guide for EVA/EVO (listed separately) has only objects 1-9 of it.
AV 12-14 and AV 22-24 carry the same names (switch-on and switch-off thresholds in remote mode); the manual does not say how the two sets differ.
AI 3 and AI 7 are both named Analog Input InP3 in the manual.
The table has no read/write column; AV objects (N2 analog outputs) are taken as writable.

source.title: Universal Gateway Instruction Manual (ProtoAir): BACnet MS/TP, BACnet IP, N2, Modbus

integration.summary: Add the RWF55 as a profile in the ProtoAir Web Configurator with a unique Node-ID and discover it at 50000 + Node-ID. For monitoring read the analog inputs, actual setpoint, actuator position and burner alarm. For BMS control turn on remote operation (AV 10), then write the remote setpoint and burner release.

minimum_points.name: Activation Remote Operation
minimum_points.why: Turns on remote (BMS) operation of the RWF55

minimum_points.name: Burner Release Remote Operation
minimum_points.why: Burner release while in remote operation

minimum_points.name: Com Status
minimum_points.why: Modbus link between ProtoAir and the RWF55

integration.enable: Remote (BMS) operation is turned on with AV 10 Activation Remote Operation; the manual gives no values for it.
setup: Device instance = Node_Offset (default 50,000) + the controller's Node-ID (1-255), so Node-ID 1 gives 50001.
ProtoAir default IP address is 192.168.1.24, mask 255.255.255.0.
Add each controller as a profile in the ProtoAir Web Configurator and give it a unique Node-ID.
Set the RWF55 port to Modbus RTU, 38400 baud, no parity, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, with a unique address.
gotchas: The manual gives no value ranges or state texts for the remote-operation objects; check the Siemens RWF55 documentation before writing them.
Two sets of remote threshold objects carry identical names (AV 12-14 and AV 22-24).
